soft_issues: At native size, some short/parted/bun profiles have similar head silhouettes; clothes, hair color and accessories carry much of the identity. The set supplies 24 coherent appearance/age combinations, not 24 completely different body silhouettes.
All elders use gray hair and glasses, so their original hairstyle differences are less distinct than adult variants.
Child portraits use cheerful closed-eye expressions while several front-facing world sprites have small open eyes; this is an expression variation rather than an identity mismatch.
false_positives: Eight sampled checker outputs report pillow shading. Visual review of every flagged sample shows discrete flat clothing planes, skin/hair material boundaries and dark limb/hat outlines; brighter left sleeve/hair edges remain directional. The elder curly portrait has deliberate asymmetrical face/glasses shading rather than a concentric light center. None of these flags was visually confirmed as pillow shading.
reasoning: All requested assets are present. Inspected the resident contact sheet, full portrait atlas, and separate age-group sheets pairing all 24 portraits with their four native actor directions. Hair family, outfit color, skin tone and accessories correspond across portrait and world sprite; front faces and rear hair/collar are distinct, and side views read as opposite directions with crisp native clusters. The muted palette, dark outlines and restrained window-sized detail match the established hand-drawn pixel game style. Exhaustive alpha-bound checks of all 672 actor cells found no empty cell or frame-edge contact; bust portraits intentionally meet their panel bottom rather than accidentally cutting off a head.
optional_polish: If stronger same-size silhouette differentiation is needed, separate the bun/parted rear-hair cluster by one native pixel, especially for elder variants, while preserving the atlas margins.
Keep face expressions allowed to vary, or align child portrait/sprite eye expression only if exact expression correspondence is a product requirement.

limitations: All 672 cells were checked for bounds; quality_check and detailed walk-pose visual review used the declared representative samples rather than all 672 frames.
Animation timing, speed, cycling, movement synchronization and runtime texture filtering were outside this review.
Portraits have opaque panel backgrounds; their checker silhouette metrics describe the whole panel and cannot be interpreted as character silhouette scores.
Generator code was not inspected; review used raster artifacts and descriptive atlas metadata.
No materials or program files were modified.
